entries.title: Job 36:1
segments: ¶Elihu also proceeded and said:

entries.title: Job 36:2
segments: "Bear with me a little, and I will show you That [there are] yet words to speak on God's behalf.

entries.title: Job 36:3
segments: I will fetch my knowledge from afar; I will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

entries.title: Job 36:4
segments: For truly my words [are] not false; One who is perfect in knowledge [is] with you.

entries.title: Job 36:5
segments: ¶"Behold, God [is] mighty, but despises [no one; He is] mighty in strength of understanding.

entries.title: Job 36:6
segments: He does not preserve the life of the wicked, But gives justice to the oppressed.

entries.title: Job 36:7
segments: He does not withdraw His eyes from the righteous; But [they are] on the throne with kings, For He has seated them forever, And they are exalted.

entries.title: Job 36:8
segments: And if [they are] bound in fetters, Held in the cords of affliction,

entries.title: Job 36:9
segments: Then He tells them their work and their transgressions-That they have acted defiantly.

entries.title: Job 36:10
segments: He also opens their ear to instruction, And commands that they turn from iniquity.

entries.title: Job 36:11
segments: If they obey and serve [Him], They shall spend their days in prosperity, And their years in pleasures.

entries.title: Job 36:12
segments: But if they do not obey, They shall perish by the sword, And they shall die without knowledge.

entries.title: Job 36:13
segments: "But the hypocrites in heart store up wrath; They do not cry for help when He binds them.

entries.title: Job 36:14
segments: They die in youth, And their life [ends] among the perverted persons.

entries.title: Job 36:15
segments: ¶He delivers the poor in their affliction, And opens their ears in oppression.

entries.title: Job 36:16
segments: "Indeed He would have brought you out of dire distress, [Into] a broad place where [there is] no restraint; And what is set on your table [would be] full of richness.

entries.title: Job 36:17
segments: But you are filled with the judgment due the wicked; Judgment and justice take hold [of you].

entries.title: Job 36:18
segments: Because [there is] wrath, [beware] lest He take you away with [one] blow; For a large ransom would not help you avoid [it].

entries.title: Job 36:19
segments: Will your riches, Or all the mighty forces, Keep you from distress?

entries.title: Job 36:20
segments: Do not desire the night, When people are cut off in their place.

entries.title: Job 36:21
segments: Take heed, do not turn to iniquity, For you have chosen this rather than affliction.

entries.title: Job 36:22
segments: "Behold, God is exalted by His power; Who teaches like Him?

entries.title: Job 36:23
segments: Who has assigned Him His way, Or who has said, 'You have done wrong'?

entries.title: Job 36:24
segments: ¶"Remember to magnify His work, Of which men have sung.

entries.title: Job 36:25
segments: Everyone has seen it; Man looks on [it] from afar.

entries.title: Job 36:26
segments: "Behold, God [is] great, and we do not know [Him]; Nor can the number of His years [be] discovered.

entries.title: Job 36:27
segments: For He draws up drops of water, Which distill as rain from the mist,

entries.title: Job 36:28
segments: Which the clouds drop down [And] pour abundantly on man.

entries.title: Job 36:29
segments: Indeed, can [anyone] understand the spreading of clouds, The thunder from His canopy?

entries.title: Job 36:30
segments: Look, He scatters his light upon it, And covers the depths of the sea.

entries.title: Job 36:31
segments: For by these He judges the peoples; He gives food in abundance.

entries.title: Job 36:32
segments: He covers [His] hands with lightning, And commands it to strike.

entries.title: Job 36:33
segments: His thunder declares it, The cattle also, concerning the rising [storm].
